item.text: The shared event manager already exposes the required `call()` and `subscribe()` methods, and payment method updates arrive under `PaymentMethods` with per-item `Action` fields. I’m adding a reusable bounded polling helper alongside that manager so callers can opt into matching a property/action without changing event manager internals.

item.text: The helper is implemented with a delayed first poll, then one `call()` after each 5 second interval, capped at five calls. Matching events clear the pending timer and unsubscribe; errors reject the returned promise after cleanup. I’m checking types and reviewing the diff now.
